purpose: Teach: 迷わ/掴む/乗れる/はやく/はやり/思い出せ/逃げ出し/見落とし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、迷わ、絶対、ないで、絶対、ご注文、絶対、選んでね
lines.en: Sho — don't hesitate. Pick whatever you want, and be absolutely sure about it.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging, leaning in. Gentle insistence. Wants him to feel confident in his choice. Soft emphasis on the affirmation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達の心、本気で、絶対、掴む、絶対、お話、絶対、できたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really did it. I got my friend to open up to me. For real.
lines.style: Quiet pride breaking through. Not bragging — genuinely surprised at himself. Small smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact but pleased.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、自転車、絶対、乗れる、絶対、ようになったよね
lines.en: Sho — you learned to ride your bike. Look at you now.
lines.style: Gentle affection. She's noticing something true about him. Unhurried, warm. The kind of praise that lands because it's specific and believed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、はやく、絶対、お家、絶対、帰りたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really want to go home soon, though.
lines.style: Small, honest admission. Not complaining — just stating a fact he notices about himself. Slightly apologetic undertone. Kid-tired.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、はやり、絶対、のお歌、絶対、知ってる?本気で
lines.en: Sho — do you know that trending song? The one everyone's listening to?
lines.style: Curious tilt. Genuine question, not testing. Soft interest. Wondering if she knows this thing he's aware of.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達の名前、本気で、絶対、思い出せ、絶対、ない時あるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — sometimes I can't remember my friends' names. It happens.
lines.style: Wry self-awareness. Not sad about it — just matter-of-fact observation. A kid admitting something slightly embarrassing and moving on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、辛い時に、本気で、絶対、逃げ出し、絶対、たくなる気持ち、絶対、わかるわ
lines.en: Sho — when things get hard, I understand that feeling. That need to just... run away.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. She's seen him struggle. No judgment — just acknowledgment that she knows this feeling too. Gentle and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テストで、本気で、絶対、見落とし、絶対、た、絶対、問題、絶対、あったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I missed a question on my test. Just didn't see it.
lines.style: Small frustration underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery. A kid processing disappointment in real time. Not dramatic — just real.
